verdict.rationale: Letta is a stateful agent platform with memory search (MemFS Search mod), so retrieval-performance benchmarks are a fair axis to judge it on. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents retrieval-latency targets or measured p50/p95 numbers. The only related item mentions keyword, semantic, and hybrid search via a mod, with no performance figures.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented retrieval-latency targets or measured numbers (e.g. p50/p95) backing the product's speed claims
